note: In a 24-patient STISS cohort, 2 individuals (8.3%) displayed interferonopathy-associated chilblains, confirming low-frequency cutaneous autoinflammatory features.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 24 additional unrelated patients with STISS due to PSMD12 variants, 2 patients exhibited chilblains resembling manifestations seen in autoinflammatory interferonopathies, alongside type I interferon gene signature activation.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: We report 24 additional unrelated patients with STISS with various truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions involving PSMD12. ... Of note, 2 patients also showed chilblains resembling signs observed in interferonopathy.

numbers.metric: patients with chilblains in expanded STISS cohort

evidence.text: A distinct report on six STISS patients from two families noted that none exhibited clinical autoinflammatory manifestations, confirming that clinical inflammatory signs are not fully penetrant in all cohorts.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating PSMD12 Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: None presented clinical manifestations of autoinflammation and the detected IFN-I signature perturbations were not specific.

numbers.metric: patients presenting clinical manifestations of autoinflammation
